NvmeSupport.description_en:
Specifies whether the built destination image supports NVMe. Valid values:
supported: supported. Instances created from this image support the NVMe protocol.
unsupported: not supported. Instances created from this image do not support the NVMe protocol.
auto: automatic detection. The system automatically detects whether the NVMe driver is installed in your image. This detection occurs before the build phase. If you install or uninstall the NVMe driver during the build, the result may be inaccurate. We recommend that you set this parameter to supported or unsupported based on the build content

构建的目标镜像是否支持 NVMe。可能值：

unsupported：不支持。表示以该镜像创建的实例不支持 NVMe 协议。
auto：自动检测。由系统自动检测您的镜像是否安装NVMe驱动，该行为发生在构建阶段前，若您在构建时安装或者卸载了NVMe驱动，可能会出现结果偏差，建议您根据构建内容设置为supported或unsupported

DiskImageSize.description_en:
The size of the custom image after the image is imported.

The space consists of the system disk and data disks. You must ensure that the size of the system disk is greater than or equal to the size of the imported image file. Valid values:

If N is set to 1, it specifies the system disk. Valid values: 1 to 2048. Unit: GiB.
If N is set to 2 to 17, it specifies a data disk. Valid values: 1 to 2048. Unit: GiB.

After you upload the source image file to OSS, you can view the size of the image file in the OSS bucket

导入镜像后，自定义镜像的空间大小。

该空间由系统盘和数据盘组成，您必须保证系统盘的空间大小大于等于导入的镜像文件大小。取值范围：

N=1时，表示系统盘，取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。
N=2~17时，表示数据盘。取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。

当您将源镜像文件上传至OSS后，可以在OSS Bucket中查看镜像文件的大小

LicenseType.description_en:
The license type used to activate the operating system after the image is imported. Valid values:

Auto: Alibaba Cloud detects the source operating system and assigns a license. In auto mode, the system first checks whether an Alibaba Cloud official channel license is available for the specified Platform and assigns it to the imported image. If no such license is available, the system switches to the BYOL (Bring Your Own License) mode.
Aliyun: uses an Alibaba Cloud official channel license based on the specified Platform.
BYOL: uses the license provided with the source operating system. If you use BYOL, you must ensure that your license key is supported on Alibaba Cloud
LicenseType.description_zh:
导入镜像后，激活操作系统采用的许可证类型。取值范围：

Auto：由阿里云检测源操作系统并分配许可证。自动模式下，系统优先搜索您设置的`Platform`是否有阿里云官方渠道的许可证并分配给导入的镜像，如果缺乏该类许可，会切换成BYOL（Bring Your Own License）方式。
Aliyun：根据您设置的`Platform`采用阿里云官方渠道的许可证。
BYOL：源操作系统自带的许可证。采用BYOL时，您必须确保您的许可证密钥支持在阿里云使用

RetentionStrategy.description_en:
The data retention policy for the imported image. Valid values:

RetainOnlySuccessful: retains the image only if the build succeeds.

RetainOnlyFailed: retains the image only if the build fails.

RetainAlways: always retains the image regardless of the build result.

RetainNever: never retains the image regardless of the build result.

Default value: RetainNever

导入镜像的保留策略。取值范围：

RetainOnlyFailed：构建失败才保留，成功则不保留。

RetainAlways：无论构建结果如何，总是保留。

RetainNever：无论构建结果如何，总是不保留。

默认值：RetainNever

RepairItem.description_en:
The image repair items.

Repair items supported by Linux:
fstab: fixes disk mount configuration issues
grub: fixes GRUB boot configuration issues
dhcp: fixes network DHCP issues
selinux: fixes Security-Enhanced Linux issues
growpart: fixes online automatic expansion issues for the root partition
cloudinit: installs the cloud-init initialization service
aegis: installs the Security Center agent service
nvme: fixes NVMe driver issues
virtio: fixes virtio driver issues
standardizedtimezone: fixes standard time zone issues
Repair items supported by Windows:
bcd: fixes boot configuration data file issues
hotfix: fixes Windows patch issues
disk: fixes disk setting issues
update: fixes Update process issues
server: fixes service configuration issues
bootmgr: fixes Windows Boot Manager issues
vminit: fixes Windows initialization agent issues
osloader: fixes Windows OS Loader issues
virtio: fixes virtio driver issues
standardizedtimezone: fixes standard time zone issues
RepairItem.description_zh:
镜像修复项。

linux支持的修复项：
fstab：磁盘挂载配置问题修复
grub：GRUB 引导配置问题修复
dhcp：网络DHCP问题修复
selinux：Security-Enhanced Linux 问题修复
growpart：根分区在线自动扩容问题修复
cloudinit：安装 cloud-init 初始化服务
aegis：云安全中心 Agent服务安装
nvme：NVMe 驱动问题修复
virtio：virtio驱动问题修复
standardizedtimezone：标准化时区问题修复
windows支持的修复项：
bcd：启动配置数据文件问题修复
hotfix：Windows 补丁问题修复
disk：磁盘设置问题修复
update：Update 进程问题修复
server：服务配置问题修复
bootmgr：Windows 启动管理器问题修复
vminit：Windows 版初始化Agent问题修复
osloader：Windows OS Loader问题修复
virtio：virtio驱动问题修复
standardizedtimezone：标准化时区问题修复

RepairMode.description_en:
The repair mode in the image template.

Valid values:
Standard: standard repair mode.

  The standard repair package for Linux systems includes:
GUESTOS.CloudInit
GUESTOS.Dhcp
GUESTOS.Virtio
GUESTOS.OnlineResizeFS
GUESTOS.Grub
GUESTOS.Fstab
GUESTOS.Nvme

  The standard repair package for Windows systems includes:
GUESTOS.Virtio
GUESTOS.Update
GUESTOS.Hotfix
GUESTOS.Server
GUESTOS.Bcd
GUESTOS.Disk
GUESTOS.Bootmgr
GUESTOS.OSLoader
GUESTOS.Vminit

All: full repair mode.

  The full repair package for Linux systems adds the following items to the standard repair package:

GUESTOS.Selinux
GUESTOS.SecurityCenterAgent

  The full repair package for Windows systems adds the following item to the standard repair package:
GUESTOS.Server


Customized: custom repair mode. In this mode, the repair items in the repair package are specified by the RepairItem parameter.

As the detection and repair capabilities continue to improve, the included repair items may increase. For more information about the specific meanings of the repair items, see [Image detection overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/439819.html）
RepairMode.description_zh:
镜像模版中的修复选项。

取值范围：
Standard：标准修复模式。

  当前Linux系统的标准修复套餐包含
GUESTOS.CloudInit
GUESTOS.Dhcp
GUESTOS.Virtio
GUESTOS.OnlineResizeFS
GUESTOS.Grub

  Windows系统的标准修复套餐包含

GUESTOS.Server
GUESTOS.Bcd
GUESTOS.Disk
GUESTOS.Bootmgr
GUESTOS.OSLoader
GUESTOS.Vminit

All：全量修复模式。

  当前Linux系统的全量修复套餐在标准修复的基础上增加了

GUESTOS.Selinux
GUESTOS.SecurityCenterAgent

  当前Windows系统的全量修复套餐在标准修复的基础上增加了
GUESTOS.Server


Customized：自定义修复模式。在该模式下，修复套餐中的修复项由RepairItem参数来指定。

随着检测修复能力的不断提升，包含的修复项可能会增加。修复项具体含义，请参见[镜像检测概述]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/439819.html）
